packageRules.description: One PR for all action bumps; they are reviewed together anyway.

Our own features, published from this repo. They are referenced by major only, so every 1.x release is picked up at build time with no file change. A 2.x would be our own decision, made in the same commit that publishes it -- not something to be told about by a bot.
Major Fedora bumps change the whole RPM surface, so keep them in their own reviewable PR.
